relationships.subject: Irisin
relationships.evidence_quote: Intraperitoneal irisin prevented LPS-induced visceral hypersensitivity and colonic hyperpermeability in a dose-dependent manner.

relationships.subject: Irisin
relationships.evidence_quote: Irisin also prevented CRF-induced gastrointestinal alterations.

relationships.subject: Irisin
relationships.evidence_quote: Irisin, a myokine, has been shown to inhibit TLR4-proinflammatory cytokine signaling

key_findings: Irisin prevented LPS- and CRF-induced visceral hypersensitivity and colonic hyperpermeability in rats; effects were reversed by AMPK, NO, D2, cholinergic and orexin-1 blockade.
